overall: The AG found a violation for late provision of November 27, 2012 minutes, but since the minutes were already provided, ordered no additional relief. The accuracy allegations were declined because they were not first filed with the committee.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to provide minutes of its November 27, 2012 open session within 10 days of her request.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide minutes within 10 days of a request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the November 27, 2012 minutes were inaccurate, but this was not first raised in a complaint filed with the committee.
allegations.key_passage: Because these allegations were not filed in an Open Meeting Law complaint with the Committee first, we decline to review them in this letter.
